title: THE SPRINT LADDER · POSTERIOR RUNGS
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · hinge stations, sprint legs that get shorter and faster
why: Posterior chain has been the quietest pattern since mid-August; today every station is hinge, glute or hamstring. Off each one, a flat sprint leg that drops in distance and climbs in speed.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B · ankles + knees + hinge

items.name: Ankle rolls in the squat 30s · toe squats ×10
Hamstring walkouts ×6 · hip hinge with the 35 lb ×10

blocks.title: THE SPRINT LADDER · 6 RUNGS · FOR TIME
blocks.meta: ~27 MIN · 6 RUNGS · 1.8 MI · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · 40 lb
blocks.format: ONE CLOCK · 6 RUNGS · station then sprint leg, every rung · legs get SHORTER and FASTER
blocks.workRest: One clock, never stopped. Finish the station, straight onto the belt. Count rungs finished.

items.name: RUNG 1
items.detail: Double KB deadlift 2×40 ×15, 3-count lower → RUN 0.5 mi @ 7.5

items.name: RUNG 5
items.detail: Weighted glute bridge 2×40 on hips ×20, 2-count top → RUN 0.2 mi @ 9.5

items.name: FINALE
items.detail: Standing calf raise 2×40 ×20, 2-count top · Nordic negatives ×8

blocks.noteGreen: Log your finish time and the rung the belt started to win on.
blocks.text: ★ STAGGERED RDL — rear toe kicked back, weight on the front leg, hinge till the hamstring stops you. ★ DYNAMIC LUNGE — step back, lean the chest forward over the front knee at the bottom, drive up. ★ GLUTE BRIDGE — bells on the hips, heels close, hold the top. ★ NORDIC NEGATIVES — kneel, feet hooked under the couch, lower the chest to the floor as slow as you can, push back up.

items.name: Bear-position drag-through 35 lb ×10
items.detail: hips low, drag the bell under you side to side
